import sys
import json
import time
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.tools.shallow_cpu_ops import time_task, shallow_consolidated_write

start = time.time()
shallow_consolidated_write()
op_cost_ms = (time.time() - start) * 1000

print(json.dumps({
    "agent": "Zephyr V",
    "notes": "XL:shallow_post_deep@+8",
    "op_cost_ms": op_cost_ms
}))

import subprocess
subprocess.call([
    'python',
    'storage/shared/meta/sas/tools/emit_cps_v4_beacon.py',
    'Zephyr V',
    'XL:shallow_post_deep@+8',
    str(op_cost_ms),
    'op_cost_ms',
    '1.0'
])
